title: Compact objects admit perfect witnesses
statement: Let X and Y be Noetherian schemes, with chosen derived categories for sheaves on X and Y, and let the derived category of quasi-coherent sheaves on X have universe-u coproducts. For every object P of the quasi-coherent derived category on X that is compact, there exist choices of derived categories on every open of X and every open of Y such that P is perfect in the sense of Scheme.IsPerfect X.

proof.text: Apply noetherian_open_derived_categories_exists separately to X and Y, obtaining local derived-category families hX and hY in the original Hom universes. Install hX as the local instance.
Apply compact_isPerfect_of_isNoetherian to P and its compactness proof. The coproduct instance is proof-irrelevant, and P.obj is P.1. Pair the resulting perfectness proof with hX and hY.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof reuses the existing compact-to-perfect theorem after separately obtaining local derived-category families; no new statements.

Proper perfect pushforward sends perfect compact objects to compact objects

from.place: right adjoint commutes with direct sums: Proper perfect pushforward has compact isomorphism tests

lean.statement:
theorem compactObject_perfect_witness
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)]
    (P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (hP : IsCompactObject P) :
    ∃ (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{wX}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)))
      (hY : ∀ U : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))),
      @Scheme.IsPerfect X _ hX P.1
